notes.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound - Our second major update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p]We hope you’ve been enjoying the challenge of [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i]! [/p][p][/p][p]Since the release of our D1 major update, we’ve kept listening closely to your feedback and carefully tracking down the issues you’ve reported. Our goal remains the same: to ensure your journey through [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound [/i]feels as smooth, intense, and rewarding as it should be.[/p][p][/p][p]The D2 Update is focused on polish, bug fixing, and stability improvements, addressing a wide range of situations that could interrupt the flow of gameplay. [/p][p]
[/p][h2]Key Fixes & Improvements[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Boss Fights & Challenges[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where striking the boss at the edge of the arena on level 4-5 could push it out of the[b] camera’s view[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Several challenge conditions (like “Kill boss with a Ragebound Art” in 3-2 or “Win the duel” in 1-1) now properly trigger and [b]reward your performance[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Rhyvashi’s encounters:[b] improved stagger cooldown[/b] and prevented attacks from lingering after defeat.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected issues where [b]skipping certain boss cutscenes[/b] (e.g., 4-5 helicopter pad) could result in Kenji being unfairly hit.[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay Flow & Checkpoints[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed multiple [b]soft-locks and freeze scenarios[/b] when pausing or restarting from a checkpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints now consistently heal Kenji across all levels, and properly [b]respect equipped talismans[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Restarting from the last checkpoint during boss fights no longer leaves the [b]health bar stuck on screen[/b].[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Level-Specific Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Various [b]collision issues[/b] were resolved (Kenji or Kumori getting stuck, clipping through bulldozers, cranes, or going out of bounds in 3-5, 2-2, S-5 and others).[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental hazards (lava, fire, etc.) now correctly respect[b] accessibility knockback settings[/b].
Several background and asset display issues corrected (floating containers in S-8, mountain edges in S-3, camera transitions in 3-5).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music and dialogue triggers[/b] are fixed in multiple levels to align correctly with progression.[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Talismans & Accessibility[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted “[b]Last Stance[/b]” to only affect melee slashes and guillotine boosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect[b] stacking effects[/b] between “No Rest for the Wicked” and “Unworthy”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessibility settings[/b] (damage, screen shake, knockback) now behave consistently across all situations.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies & Animations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Corrected [b]erratic behavior[/b] in enemies like Bio Harpies, Flying Turrets, and Bio Blockers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Kumori-specific issues[/b] (Guillotine charge talisman wrongly affecting Kenji, roll/jump behaviors).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]visual consistency[/b] for certain attacks and [b]death animations[/b] (Cyclops Demon’s eye, Rhyvashi waves, etc.).[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]System & Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Application now detects [b]Windows language settings [/b]on first launch instead of defaulting to English.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional improvements to [b]performance and stability[/b] across the game.[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Moving Forward[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re grateful for the detailed reports and feedback you’ve been sharing with us. [/p][p]Every fix we implement brings us closer to delivering the sharpest possible [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] experience. Please continue letting us know if you encounter issues, your insights help us track and refine every detail![/p][p][/p][p]Stay sharp, ninjas! [/p][p][/p][p]And thank you once again for being part of this journey with us! ⚔️[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2542120/NINJA_GAIDEN_Ragebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]To defeat demons, you must stay one step ahead. Follow us on social media and never miss a strike:[/p][p][b]X - Twitter[/b] :[/p][list][*][p][url="https://x.com/Dotemu"][u]X - Dotemu[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/TheGameKitchen"][u]X - The Game Kitchen[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/TeamNINJAStudio"][u]X - Team NINJA Studio[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]And join us on[url="https://bsky.app/profile/dotemu.bsky.social"] [u]Bluesky[/u][/url],[url="https://www.facebook.com/gaming/dotemu"] [u]Facebook[/u][/url],[url="https://www.threads.net/@dotemugames"] [u]Threads[/u][/url],[url="https://www.instagram.com/dotemugames/"] [u]Instagram[/u][/url],[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@dotemu"] [u]TikTok[/u][/url], and[url="https://discord.gg/RPxFsWMTdA"] [u]Discord[/u][/url]![/p]

notes.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound - "D1" Major Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] has been out for a few weeks now, and we're absolutely thrilled with your response — thank you to everyone who’s been playing![/p][p][/p][p]Since launch, the team has been actively working on providing you with this major update, bringing new features, improvements, and a host of bug fixes![/p][p][/p][h2]Update Changelogs[/h2][h3]New features & improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Restart from Checkpoint[/b] option added. [/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to restarting the entire level, you may now restart from the last checkpoint you found. This will let you quickly retry a level section or boss without the need of getting yourself killed.[/p][list][*][p][b]Hard Mode can now be unlocked by winning the duel against Ryu.[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to the Hard Mode being unlocked by finishing the game for the first time, you may unlock it earlier by winning the duel against Ryu on level 1-1. If you want to leap right away to Hard Mode, you will first have to prove yourself worthy of the challenge![/p][list][*][p][b]New dialogues[/b] have been added at the beginning of levels S-4, S-5 and S-6.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]new alternative dialogue portrait[/b] for the Masked Agent on level 4-4 has been added.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hit stop[/b] and [b]Screen shake[/b] can be now [b]disabled[/b] through [b]Accessibility settings[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Golden Skins are now available immediately upon achieving S rank on all levels, without the need to complete the final level afterwards.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added many sound effects on enemies, projectiles and menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted required kills to achieve the highest score on level 3-2 on Hard Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Kenji could climb a wall and leave the camera's field of view towards the end of level 3-5.[/p][/*][*][p]Large obstacle meant to be destroyed by Hypercharge was vulnerable to Kama Spider Weapon on stage 3-1.[/p][/*][*][p]Luring a Cursed Fire enemy towards the collapsing platform allowed Kenji to get stuck in level 3-4.[/p][/*][*][p]During Rhyvashi's boss fight, the big rock could block your attacks right after disappearing during a brief period of time.[/p][/*][*][p]In level 4-5 on Hard Mode, Kenji could be hit when skipping the cutscene in which he jumps onto a helicopter.[/p][/*][*][p]Motorbike could flip after jumping against a wall on stage 2-2.[/p][/*][*][p]In level 4-1, Kenji could roll through some steel containers which made him out of bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Kenji could be killed by skipping the cutscene right after defeating Jagäzk on level 4-6.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for DirectInput controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]If Kumori were to perform a roll attack whilst wearing the Black Spider Uniform, the default skin would be displayed during the animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed invisible ceiling on level S-6 on Hard Mode, near the end of the tree section.[/p][/*][*][p]Bio Grunts frequently remained locked in their attack animation for a brief time if Kenji was positioned close to their spawn point.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 5-1 you could lose control of Kenji or Kumori when starting Rhyvahsi’s fight.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 5-1, a long wait time was present after defeating Rhyvashi.[/p][/*][*][p]Kenji could climb over a wall and skip part of the level, causing camera issues on level 3-5 on Hard Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]The kill streak counter disappeared every time the game was paused or cutscene took place.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 3-2 on Hard Mode, a Hanging Demon enemy could end up frozen and unable to attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 4-4 boss shockwave projectiles could appear in the air rather than on a surface.[/p][/*][*][p]Striking Level 4-4 boss in the back with a Hypercharge attack pushed it to the other edge, making it behave incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]During the elevator section on level 4-4, drone enemies could attack Kenji while being outside the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Bio Blocker's enemy projectile hitbox remained active after being killed.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 3-2, during the Eels boss fight, the camera could be unlocked if Kenji reached a low point of the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Gurthka’s landing animation could not work properly when the boss fight started on levels 1-2 and 1-3.[/p][/*][*][p]Jagäzk’s ribcage was immune to the Grenade Spider Weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 4-2, you could leave the camera bounds by using guillotine boosts on a helicopter.[/p][/*][*][p]Kumori’s Hypercharged roll-jump kunai projectile could traverse an enemy without hitting it.[/p][/*][*][p]On level S-8, a guillotine boost platforming section could be skipped by climbing a wall and moving through the ceiling.[/p][/*][*][p]On level 2-2 the player could lose control of the motorbike when reaching the outdoor area.[/p][/*][*][p]While playing as Kumori during a Demon Altar section, Kumori wouldn’t be able to manually hypercharge if Kenji’s health was too low.[/p][/*][*][p]Cyclops Demon's eye disappeared instantly rather than using a proper animation if the enemy was killed and the eye was away from their body.[/p][/*][*][p]Kenji could clip through the subway tunnel's ceiling during his epilogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Backtracking during Kenji's epilogue could cause inconsistent camera transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting the credits from the main menu caused the music to reset and make the portraits not move properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Many other performance improvements and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Time to slash some demons, Ninjas! ⚔️
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2542120/NINJA_GAIDEN_Ragebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]To defeat demons, you must stay one step ahead. notes.title: NINJA GAIDEN: RAGEBOUND IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Dive into an untold chapter of the NINJA GAIDEN saga with [b][i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i][/b], [b][u]AVAILABLE NOW[/u][/b]!
[/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/va0pPZjGdUI" style="button"]DISCOVER THE LAUNCH TRAILER NOW![/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343417/0c204966d366c5f394f3c56074434a9ad01f87a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Combining old-school feeling with modern precision, [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] retains the pick-up-and-play action of the classic titles while introducing new layers of depth.
[/p][p][i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] continues the saga of the original NES NINJA GAIDEN, and starts when [b]Ryu Hayabusa[/b] must leave the Hayabusa Village and journey to America to honor his father's will.[/p][p]While he is away, the veil between the human and the demon realms suddenly shatters, unleashing a terrifying army of demons upon the Hayabusa Village, which now faces an unprecedented threat in Ryu's absence. Kenji Mozu, a fledgling Hayabusa Clan Ninja, must then rise to face the forces of evil.

notes.title: Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound (PC) Review
notes.content:
Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound, along with Ninja Gaiden 2 Black, are among some of the biggest surprises for me in 2025. And just like 2 Black, I’m happy to report that the latest game from DotEmu and The Game Kitchen is an excellent addition to the beloved franchise created by Koei Tecmo, feeling like a renaissance for the Ninja Gaiden property.

Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound marries the classic NES-era Ninja Gaiden games with some of the conventions found in the Xbox and modern Ninja Gaiden titles, successfully creating a new entry that fits comfortably into the legacy of the original trilogy. Akin to the theme of bridging old and new elements, Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound features a story that sees the Hayabusa clan come together with their nemesis, the Black Spider Clan.

notes.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound - Kumori Reveal
notes.content:
Today, we are ecstatic to announce [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i]'s second playable character, [b]Kumori[/b], a member of the antagonistic [b]Black Spider Clan[/b] central to the NINJA GAIDEN series!🕷️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343417/902502b0aec6b9756e5f5c6c87b0f00eb5039503.png[/img]
By wielding [b]modern weaponry[/b] and [b]demonic sources of power[/b] to reach her goals and brave challenges unique to her story, Kumori’s fighting style leaves traditional rules behind to emerge victorious from battle by any means necessary!

[h3]Discover Kumori’s devastating abilities in our new trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=U1X0Ot401Tk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] begins immediately after the opening moments of the original NES [i]NINJA GAIDEN[/i].

The veil between the human and demon realms has broken, leaving the world linked with a gate to darkness. After Ryu Hayabusa leaves the Hayabusa Village to avenge his father, [b]Kenji Mozu[/b], a fledgling [b]Hayabusa Clan Ninja[/b] and protagonist of [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i], rises to confront the forces of evil. In this dark era, the destinies of Kenji and Kumori intersect as they overcome the generational grudges of their clans. In the face of peril, their only way to survive is to use the forbidden power that merges Kumori's spirit with Kenji's.

[i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i]’s demon-slaying tale weaves between the journeys of the two ninjas, delivering exhilarating, monster-ridden levels unique to each character as well as challenges requiring the creative use of their fusion.
Kenji and Kumori’s high-stakes quests develop with showstopping fights against powerful, boss-caliber behemoths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343417/4786d841c6ca039f36ac32ee8af6deb297df56dd.gif[/img]

With [b]upgradable abilities[/b], [b]hidden collectibles[/b], [b]unlockable secret missions[/b], [b]optional challenges[/b], and more, [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] is a thrilling modernization of the tense, satisfyingly swift battles and precise, skill-demanding platforming the series is known for.

notes.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound launches Summer 2025!
notes.content:
We are proud and excited to announce [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i], the newest chapter in the iconic [i]NINJA GAIDEN[/i] series! With this new title, we aim to recapture the essence of what made the original games unforgettable: classic side-scrolling gameplay, fast-paced combat, and the precise platforming that hardcore fans know and love, with a fresh twist for a new generation of players.

Born from a passion for retro games and a deep love for the [i]NINJA GAIDEN[/i] series, [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] is being developed by [b]The Game Kitchen[/b], the acclaimed studio behind [i]Blasphemous 1 & 2[/i].

[b]Watch the reveal Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=d8DK6Dl3RvA;full][/previewyoutube]

This new chapter introduces [b]Kenji Mozu[/b] to the series, a young ninja trained by none other than Ryu Hayabusa himself. His story begins when Ryu departs for America to honor his father’s will. In Ryu’s absence, chaos erupts as the barrier between the human and the demon worlds suddenly shatters. With his village under threat, Kenji has a chance to make a name for himself by standing up for his people and protecting them from a sinister new menace.
Along the way, Kenji will take on showstopping battles against boss-caliber behemoths, uncover hidden collectibles, upgrade his abilities, and tackle optional mission objectives. [i]NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound[/i] reimagines the series’ signature tense, precise platforming and satisfyingly swift combat while honoring its roots.
